papers.title: Selective laser melting of Al–Si–10Mg alloy: microstructural studies and mechanical properties assessment
papers.abstract: Additive Manufacturing (AM) technique is widely recognized by aerospace sectors for its potential to fabricate complex shape components directly from a Computer-Aided Model data (CAM). Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is an innovative method high degree of adaptability among different AM techniques. SLM is one of the AM techniques adopted to produce the three-dimensional complex shape components. Current research work focuses on fabricating an Al–Si–10Mg aluminium alloy by SLM process which is studied for the influence of scanning speed and build orientation on the mechanical strength and surface finish of the as built component compared with as casted specimen. The importance of the sample studied for the scanning speed and built direction is relatively essential exclusively for dynamic applications. The as-built samples surface micrographs was surprisingly refined with a progressively reduced grain size diameter from 7.2 μm to 5.5 μm by increasing scanning speed compared to that of AlSi10Mg parts (∼9.1 μm). The mean layer thickness increased from 20 μm to 30 μm by decreasing the scanning speed from 500 mm/s to 200 mm/s. Attractive advantage of the Orowan mechanism, fine grain strengthening, and the graded interfacial layer, a considerably-high microhardness (135 ± 3.1HV), and enhanced mechanical properties were achieved.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金SLM工艺，无生物医学背景，不涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structures, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究扫描速度和构建方向对SLM制备Al-Si-10Mg合金力学性能和表面质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变扫描速度和构建方向进行SLM实验，表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 提高扫描速度使晶粒细化，显微硬度达135 HV，力学性能优于铸态。
summary_zh.validation: 与铸态试样对比，进行显微硬度和表面形貌测量。

summary_en.motivation: This work investigates the influence of scanning speed and build orientation on the mechanical strength and surface finish of SLM-fabricated Al-Si-10Mg alloy.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of Al-Si-10Mg was performed at varying scanning speeds and build orientations, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: Increasing scanning speed refined grain size from 7.2 μm to 5.5 μm and enhanced microhardness to 135±3.1 HV, outperforming as-cast counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted by comparing as-built samples with as-cast specimens through microhardness and surface morphology analysis.

papers.title: Evolution of temperature and residual stress behavior in selective laser melting of 316L stainless steel across a cooling channel
papers.abstract: Purpose The current investigation aims at observing the influence of the cooling channel on the thermal and residual stress behavior of the selective laser melting (SLM)316L uni-layer thermo-mechanical model. Design/methodology/approach On a thermo-mechanical model with a cooling channel, the effect of scanning direction, parallel and perpendicular and scan spacing was simulated. The effect of underlying solid and powder bases was evaluated on residual stress profile and thermal variables at various locations. Findings The high heat dissipation of solid base due to high cooling rates and steep thermal gradients can reciprocate with smaller melt pool temperature and melt pool size. Given the same scan spacing, residual stresses were found lower when laser scanning was perpendicular to the cooling channel. Moreover, large scan spacing was found to increase residual stresses. Originality/value Cooling channels are increasingly being used in additive manufacturing; however, their effect on the residual stress behavior of the SLM component is not extensively studied. This research can serve as a foundation for further inquiries into the impact of base material design such as cooling channels on manufactured components using SLM.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究316L不锈钢SLM过程中的冷却通道影响，与生物医学植入物无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant design, no osseointegration, no mechanical testing, no porous structure, no fatigue analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究冷却通道对SLM中热和残余应力行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 建立316L不锈钢单层热-机械有限元模型，模拟不同扫描方向和间距。
summary_zh.result: 垂直于冷却通道扫描且小间距可降低残余应力。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of a cooling channel on thermal and residual stress evolution during selective laser melting of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: A thermo-mechanical finite element model of a single layer with an embedded cooling channel was developed, simulating parallel and perpendicular scanning directions and varying scan spacing.
summary_en.result: Perpendicular scanning relative to the cooling channel and smaller scan spacing reduced residual stresses.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation only, without experimental validation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用选区激光熔化技术制备Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架并进行了压缩测试，与研究方向的增材制造生物医学材料直接相关，但未涉及疲劳性能或骨整合评估。
llm.why_not_core: Does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration studies; only static compression is reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM制备多孔钛合金支架用于骨组织工程
summary_zh.method: 改变激光参数制造不同孔隙率支架并压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 较高激光功率和扫描速度导致孔隙率降低和力学性能变化

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate porous Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds with tailored mechanical properties for biomedical applications using selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: SLM parameters were varied to produce scaffolds with different porosities, and compressive mechanical tests were performed.
summary_en.result: Higher laser power and scan speed reduced porosity and altered mechanical strength.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression test results were compared with literature values.
